svg.text: MVC ceiling: 200 threads / 0.1 s per request ≈ 2,000 req/s, then requests queue up.

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', 'Chalkboard SE', cursive

svg.text: WebFlux: threads never wait, so the limit becomes CPU / network, not the thread count.

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', 'Chalkboard SE', cursive

svg.text: Catch: ONE blocking call on an event-loop thread freezes every request sharing it.
